messages:
Eli (CSM): Heads-up from Meridian: they want to shorten their upcoming renewal from 12mo to 9mo and drop 10 seats. Asking for a prorated credit and will send a new PO from their reseller contact (partners@resellco.io). They asked if this can be done before the renewal window closes next week. @Nora @Sam @Aisha :wave:

Nora (AM): Is the 9mo term a negotiated commercial change or a billing-side request? We should confirm whether pricing tiers change with shorter term (discounts). If it's pure billing, finance can do a credit memo.

Eli (CSM): Customer message says: "we'd like a 9-month bridge because of headcount freeze. Pricing per-seat stays same; just want invoice adjusted and seats prorated." They also want the credit applied against the Feb invoice rather than roll forward.

Sam (Finance): We can apply a credit memo against INV-2026-0023 if they provide: 1) new PO referencing INV-2026-0023 or subscription id, 2) confirmation of authorized signer (email from an on-file approver or a delegation letter). Processing time ~48h after docs. If they want term change (contract amendment) legal must review.

Aisha (Legal): Because a reseller is involved, we need reseller authorization showing partners@resellco.io is allowed to issue POs on Meridian's behalf. Two acceptable items: (A) Meridian email delegating procurement to ResellCo (from an on-file approver), OR (B) a reseller-authorized SOW/addendum signed by Meridian + ResellCo. If they insist on changing the contract term (12 -> 9), that's a contractual amendment and needs signature from Meridian's legal or exec sponsor.

Nora (AM): Suggestion: ask customer to choose one path: (1) billing-only: send PO + delegation email and we'll issue credit memo; (2) contractual: submit amendment request and we'll route to Legal for execution (longer). Provide templates.

Eli (CSM): Sent this at 10:02 PT with both templates and a PO example. Included sample language for delegation: "I, <Name>, authorized signer for Meridian (Title), delegate procurement authority to partners@resellco.io for invoice INV-2026-0023."

procurement-bot: Thread tagged: renewal-short-term-request, priority: medium.

Meridian (Customer) [quoted by Eli]: "We'll go billing-only route. ResellCo can send PO from partners@resellco.io and former CFO will email delegation to procurement@meridian.com. Can you confirm prorate method?"

Sam (Finance): Prorate method: calculate unused seat-days from effective change date to end of billing period and credit at per-seat list price after any volume discounts. We'll draft CM with breakdown and share before applying. Confirm effective date and target invoice to apply credit.

Eli (CSM): They asked to apply to Feb invoice INV-2026-0023 and proposed effective date 2026-02-10.

Aisha (Legal): If they're only doing billing, still need that delegation email from an on-file approver. Ask them to CC legal@resellco.io so ResellCo is in the loop. If delegation includes a signature image, make sure it's on company letterhead.

Nora (AM): I'll prepare the quick checklist for Eli to send: required fields on PO, delegation sample, and the expected timeline (48h after docs).

Eli (CSM): Sent checklist at 10:21 PT. Customer replied 10:45 PT with PO attached (PO-RES-8897) and a short delegation email from their former CFO (cc'd legal@resellco.io). Attached: PO PDF and delegation text.

procurement-bot: Attachment detected (PO-RES-8897.pdf). Saved to renewal artifacts.

Sam (Finance): Received PO + delegation. I'll queue credit memo CM-2026-110 and calculate prorate. Please confirm seat counts: original 50 seats, dropping 10 -> new 40.

Eli (CSM): Confirmed counts.

Sam (Finance): Draft CM ready. Breakdown:
- Gross seat credit: 10 seats * $400/month * prorate fraction from 2026-02-10 to 2026-02-28 = X
- Apply discount factor: 10% volume discount -> net credit = ... (will fill numbers in system).

Aisha (Legal): Delegation email looks valid (sent from on-file CFO). No contractual amendment required since they selected billing-only. Proceed.

Sam (Finance): Applying CM-2026-110 to INV-2026-0023 now. Expect update in AR within 24h. Tagging as "applied" once done.

Eli (CSM): Thanks team. Action items:
- Sam: finalize and apply credit memo (ETA 24h)
- Aisha: close legal review (done)
- Nora: update renewal notes to reflect 9mo decision (commercial unchanged)
- Eli: confirm customer sees applied credit and update case.

procurement-bot: Thread closed: renewal-short-term-request. Logged change: seats reduced, credit applied.
